units.source_text: 阿时的对象是个江湖画师，他奔走于旅馆之间，为隔扇作画。

en.t: Ashi's partner was an itinerant painter who went from inn to inn painting sliding partitions.

units.source_text: 阿时这个农村姑娘虽然眼睛深陷，有点迟钝，

en.t: Although Ashi, this country girl, had sunken eyes and seemed a little slow,

units.source_text: 可在温泉澡塘里，她那身白皙的肌肤显得格外艳美，就像换了一个人。

en.t: in the hot spring bath, her fair skin looked exceptionally radiant and beautiful, as if she had become another person.
